inventory.sell_evidence: All4795 rows have sell=0 or empty and sell_price empty; no verified sell-enabled items.
inventory.unsupported: Random gifts, selectable gifts, timed/resource packs and server-dependent actions need their own exact handlers; do not apply generic consume-all.

idle.tuple_interpretation: mainlinemdl.getFixedHangIncome maps tuple[0] item ID and tuple[1] rate; the third field is ignored by this client display. Its general server meaning is not asserted.
idle.cap_source: hang_up_cfg1[3] used as minutes in mainlinectrl.openHangRwdSucc; actual max_time supplied by16400 response and overrides display cap.
idle.rounding_note: Client receives sum_goods from server; a local formula floor(rate*elapsedSeconds/60) is an offline adaptation, not recovered server rounding. Preserve fractional remainder to avoid repeated-claim loss if implementing it.
idle.base_rate_modifiers: getFixedHangIncome applies privilege value/10000; hangdetail applies server item_list.rate/10000. Without verified entitlement/state use no bonus.
source_modules: mlhangup.ts.js clamps server time-gain_time to max_time
